# Zhara AI Search & Discovery

> Zhara AI Search & Discovery is a Shopify app that adds AI-powered product search, predictive autocomplete, trending searches and products, and personalized product recommendations to Shopify storefronts, with search analytics that connect discovery to revenue. It is built by Zhara Labs in Ahmedabad, India.

Zhara pairs fast keyword search (typo-tolerant, with synonyms) with semantic AI search as a fallback, so shoppers find products even when their words don't match the catalog, for example "something warm for winter". Merchants control results with merchandising rules and see how search and recommendations turn into sales. It installs through Shopify theme app extensions, so it does not change the merchant's theme code.

## Product

- [Home](https://zhara.io/): overview of search, discovery, merchandising and analytics
- [AI product search](https://zhara.io/#product): intent-based natural-language search with typo tolerance, synonyms and contextual ranking
- [Discovery and recommendations](https://zhara.io/#discovery): trending searches and products before a shopper types, predictive autocomplete, and personalized recommendations in search, on the home page and on product pages
- [Merchandising](https://zhara.io/#features): boost and pin products, synonym groups, keyword redirects, exclusions, no-result recovery, and appearance settings matched to the store's theme
- [Search analytics](https://zhara.io/#analytics): searches, top terms, no-result searches, click-through, add-to-cart, conversion and search-attributed revenue
- [Getting started](https://zhara.io/#how): install the app, index the catalog, activate on the storefront

## Help

- [FAQ](https://zhara.io/faq/): answers on setup, supported themes, pricing (free), search behaviour, merchandising rules, analytics, privacy and uninstalling
- [Help and support](https://zhara.io/help/): contact form and support email (support@zhara.io)
- [Store privacy policy wording](https://zhara.io/help/store-privacy-policy/): suggested text merchants can add to their own store privacy policy

## Legal

- [Terms of Service](https://zhara.io/terms/): agreement between Zhara Labs and Shopify merchants, including plans, billing and liability
- [Privacy Policy](https://zhara.io/privacy/): what merchant and shopper data the app collects, how it is used, retention and privacy rights
- [Data Processing Addendum](https://zhara.io/legal/dpa/): processor terms for shopper personal data, including EU Standard Contractual Clauses
- [Subprocessors](https://zhara.io/legal/subprocessors/): third parties that process data (Microsoft Azure, including Azure OpenAI Service, in India)
